title: College Football
description:
Ball State at Ohio State
The Ohio State Buckeyes host the Ball State Cardinals at Ohio Stadium for Week 1. National contender Ohio State welcomes their neighbor Ball State to the Horseshoe for a non-conference game to kick off their 2026 college football schedules.

title: College Football
description:
Northern Illinois at Iowa
The Iowa Hawkeyes host the Northern Illinois Huskies at Kinnick Stadium for Week 1. The Huskies aim to recover following a 35-31 loss in its season finale, while Iowa looks to build momentum off a 34-27 ReliaQuest Bowl victory in the last season.

title: College Football
description:
Hampton at Maryland
The Hampton Pirates play the Maryland Terrapins at SECU Stadium to open the 2026 season. Both programs look to bounce back in their Week 1 opener after concluding their respective 2025 campaigns with season-ending road setbacks.
